articles.summary: Quoin Expects to Initiate Phase 2 Study in 2H 2026, Study Plans to Enroll 6-8 Pediatric and Adult Patients in the U.S. and Europe FDA Expressed No Safety Concerns Over Study Design and Duration of Dosing First-Ever Formal Clinical Study for a Potential Peeling Skin Syndrome Therapy Second Cleared
articles.title: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Receives FDA IND Clearance to Initiate Phase 2 Study of QRX003 in Peeling Skin Syndrome
